summary: This Form 6-K filing by Himalaya Shipping Ltd. (HSHP), a Bermuda-incorporated foreign private issuer, reports the conversion of index-linked time charters for four vessels to fixed rate time charters at approximately US$56,500 per day for June 2026. No special situation such as a merger, acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring is involved. The filing is a routine operational disclosure of charter contract modifications, with no board actions, advisors, or structural changes. As a standard current report, it does not trigger a special-situations classification. No deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
